verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਪਾਂਚੋ ਤਤ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਨਵਨ ਮਨ  ਤਾਂ ਮੈ ਉਤਪਤ ਹੁਇ ਸਮਾਤ ਸਭ ਤਾਹੀ ਮੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise paa(n)cho tat bikhai basudhaa navan man  taa(n) mai utapat hui samaat sabh taahee mai ||

en.bdb: Just as Earth is most humble out of the five elements. That is why it produces so much and all that goes back to it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਪਾਂਚੋ ਆਂਗੁਰੀ ਮੈ ਸੂਖਮ ਕਨੁੰਗ੍ਰੀਆ ਹੈ ਕੰਚਨ ਖਚਤ ਨਗ ਸੋਭਤ ਹੈ ਵਾਹੀ ਮੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise paa(n)cho aa(n)guree mai sookham kanu(n)greeaa hai ka(n)chan khachat nag sobhat hai vaahee mai ||

en.bdb: Just as the little finger of the hand is smallest and frail looking, yet a diamond ring is worn in it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਨੀਚ ਜੋਨ ਗਨੀਅਤ ਅਤਿ ਮਾਖੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਮ ਹੀਰ ਚੀਰ ਮਧੁ ਉਪਜਤ ਸੁਖ ਜਾਹੀ ਮੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise neech jon ganeeat at maakhee kiram heer cheer madh upajat sukh jaahee mai ||

en.bdb: Just as fly and other insects are counted among the low species, yet some of them produce such valuable things like silk, pearls, honey etc;

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਨਾਮਾ ਬਿਦਰ ਕਬੀਰ ਭਏ ਹੀਨ ਜਾਤਿ ਊਚ ਪਦ ਪਾਏ ਸਭ ਕਾਹੀ ਮੈ ॥੬੩੨॥
verses.translit_en: taise ravidhaas naamaa bidhar kabeer bhe heen jaat uooch padh paae sabh kaahee mai ||632||

en.bdb: Similarly, saints like Bhagat Kabir, Namdev Ji, Bidar and Ravi Das Ji being low born have attained a much higher spiritual level who have blessed humanity with their precept that have made their life peaceful and comfortable.
